title: LLMs Think with DAGs: Probing the Latent Graph Structure of Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2601.17593v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models often externalize reasoning as linear chains, but many reasoning problems can be more naturally modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), where intermediate conclusions branch, merge, and are reused. Whether such graph structure is reflected in model internals remains unclear. We introduce Reasoning DAG Probing to answer this question. We formalize each premise, intermediate conclusion, and final answer as a DAG node, and train lightweight probes to predict node depth, pairwise distance, and adjacency from LLM hidden states. Across logical, mathematical, and code reasoning benchmarks, we find that DAG structure is meaningfully encoded in LLM representations: it peaks in intermediate layers, with later layers preferentially recover deeper nodes and longer-range reasoning dependencies, and becomes stronger with model scale. translated_title: 大语言模型以有向无环图进行思考：探查推理的潜在图结构
translated_abstract: 大语言模型通常将推理外化为线性链条，但许多推理问题可以更自然地建模为有向无环图（DAG），其中间结论会分支、合并并被复用。这种图结构是否反映在模型内部仍不清楚。我们提出“推理DAG探查”方法来回答这个问题。我们将每个前提、中间结论和最终答案形式化为DAG节点，并训练轻量级探针从大语言模型的隐藏状态中预测节点深度、节点对距离和邻接关系。在逻辑、数学和代码推理基准测试中，我们发现DAG结构在大语言模型的表征中得到了有意义的编码：这种结构在中间层达到峰值，较深的层优先恢复更深的节点和更长程的推理依赖，且随模型规模增大而变得更强。DAG结构在自回归生成过程中也逐步显现，其方式与……
tldr: 本文提出“推理DAG探查”方法，首次证实大语言模型的内部表征确实编码了推理过程的有向无环图（DAG）结构，该结构在中间层最强、随模型规模增大而增强，并在自回归生成过程中逐步涌现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Reasoning DAG Probing and shows that LLM hidden states meaningfully encode the DAG structure of reasoning—strongest in intermediate layers, growing with model scale, and progressively emerging during autoregressive generation.
